text: I feel like an observer, standing at a threshold between action and reflection. In the first room, people collaborate, sharing thoughts within the boundaries of glass and structure. Outside, I stand quietly, separated, watching knowledge evolve. In the second space, I see R+D and words about innovation and coexistence. This artistic display is loud and thoughtful, sparking curiosity within me about the nature of research, collective progress, and the environments that shape our ideas. Amidst movement and conversation, I sense the pulse of discovery and the weight of observation.
